Belgian Defence

Belgian Defence recruitment fitness

ENTRY FITNESS TEST

At a glance

Belgian Defence publishes a side bridge and an incremental treadmill run for general recruitment. Specialist candidates may face additional assessments.

FEATURED ACTIVITYProgressive treadmill6 km/h start · 2% incline

What the test includes

  • Side bridge — left and right — Hold as long as possible
  • Progressive treadmill run — Role-specific scoring table

Some programmes include more than the activities listed here.

Test protocol and standards

Belgian Defence publishes a side bridge and an incremental treadmill run for general recruitment. Specialist candidates may face additional assessments.

Official information checked 2026-11-24. Confirm current requirements with the test publisher.

ActivityPublished requirementHow it works
Side bridge — left and rightHold as long as possibleBoth sides are tested, separated by five minutes.
Progressive treadmill runRole-specific scoring tableOne-minute warm-up; begin at 6 km/h, increase speed by 0.3 km/h each 30 s at a constant 2% grade.

Scoring and scope

Use the current official score tables for the role. No uniform minimum is asserted here; the treadmill protocol is not a 20 m beep test.

How to prepare

Independent training guidance, not official test instructions. Scale sessions to your current capacity and recover between demanding efforts.

  • Practise side bridges on both sides with a steady body position.
  • Build easy running and treadmill familiarity before progressive sessions.
  • Use the safety clip and a supervisor for demanding treadmill testing.

Putting it into a training week

Choose two or three repeatable sessions addressing the listed movements and aerobic demand. Leave recovery between harder efforts; record comparable results rather than testing maximally every week.

Common mistakes

  • Holding the treadmill handrails to maintain speed.
  • Changing the incline or comparing this run to an outdoor shuttle score.

What to log

Record both side-bridge times and final treadmill speed, grade and duration.

Avoid repeated maximal tests and sudden load increases. Stop if pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms occur; use qualified supervision where appropriate.

Official test instructions

The organisation running the test is the best place to check the latest rules and requirements.
